name: Birch-Murnaghan equation of state (third order)
principles: energy-volume curvature defines the bulk modulus
formulaTeX: E(V) = E_0 + \frac{9 V_0 B_0}{16}\left[(x-1)^3 B_0' + (x-1)^2 (6 - 4x)\right], \quad x = \left(\frac{V_0}{V}\right)^{2/3}
conventions: V_0 is the equilibrium volume: dE/dV = 0 there
B_0 = V (d^2 E / dV^2) evaluated at V_0; positive for a mechanically stable crystal
B_0' = dB/dP at P = 0, dimensionless; B_0' = 4 recovers the second-order form
E(V) is exactly a cubic polynomial in V^(-2/3), so the fit is linear least squares — no optimiser, no initial guess
total energies are basis- and method-dependent and are NOT comparable across codes; V_0, B_0 and the band gap are
expectedLimits: E(V) attains its minimum at V_0
B_0 > 0; B_0' typically 3-5 for tetrahedral semiconductors
a fit whose V_0 falls outside the sampled volume range is an extrapolation, not a result
envelopes below are set by system and method (silicon, GGA-PBE, norm-conserving pseudopotentials) — they bound a plausible calculation, not the experimental truth
experimental silicon for contrast: a_0 = 5.431 A, B_0 = 97.9 GPa, indirect gap 1.17 eV; semilocal DFT is expected to miss these

the a_0 envelope is +/-0.5% about 5.4716 A, the all-electron PBE value from an independent FP-LAPW reference run; it is a plausibility band for a converged PBE calculation, and well-converged codes in the Delta-gauge studies agree far tighter than this

the a_0 envelope is deliberately asymmetric with respect to the experimental value and symmetric with respect to the PBE one: PBE overestimates a_0 for silicon, so an agreeing pair near 5.47 A is expected and a result near the experimental 5.431 A would indicate the wrong functional, not a better calculation
an earlier a_0 lower bound of 5.4 A admitted the LDA answer (5.4043 A) and so would have passed a run that silently used the wrong exchange-correlation functional; the bound is raised to close that

the a_0 envelope width (0.055 A) is essentially the cross-method tolerance (1% relative), so any a_0 spread large enough to trip that tolerance also puts at least one engine outside this envelope — the same coupling already noted for B_0
